persona: Professional, Analytical, Ambitious, Modern, Confident, Intelligent, Clean, Memorable

primary_heading.style: Oversized editorial display headings, serif, tracking-tight, high-contrast.

accent_metadata.style: Compact uppercase, tracking-wider, used for tags and metadata to hint at data/analytics.

colors.rules: No rainbow gradients, no excessive purple gradients, no bright neon cyan everywhere, no giant glowing blobs. Subtle and premium gradients if used. High contrast text on dark backgrounds.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain/noise overlay on the background to remove digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #2A2F3A, used to create 'Technical' grid layouts for bento boxes.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Rely on borders and background shifts for depth in dark mode.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used for floating navigation on scroll (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0D14]/70 border-b border-[#2A2F3A]/50).
visual_enhancers.hero_overlay: Analytical dot-grid background in the hero section, very subtle (opacity-10).

layouts.hero: Asymmetric two-column. Name ARPITA NAIR as the strongest visual element (H1), professional photo in an elegant editorial frame with subtle parallax. CTAs grouped elegantly.
layouts.bento_strip: Professional Snapshot. A horizontal or grid-based strip summarizing Program, Specialization, University, CGPA, and Career Direction. Use technical borders.
layouts.featured_projects: Alternating asymmetrical layouts (image left/text right, then text left/image right). Oversized numbers (01, 02) tucked behind or alongside the content.
layouts.skills: Grouped bento/tag blocks. No percentage bars. Clean, data-inspired tag clusters.
layouts.career_direction: Typography-led vertical flow: TECHNOLOGY → DATA → INSIGHTS → BUSINESS DECISIONS.
layouts.contact: Dramatic oversized text 'LET'S CONNECT.' Big interactive links for EMAIL ME, LINKEDIN, GITHUB.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. py-24 or py-32 for section padding. gap-8 to gap-16 for grid items.

grids.general: 12-column grid system for desktop. Mobile-first stacking.
grids.bento: Strict grid hierarchy, dense and compact spacing for data-heavy sections (Snapshot, Skills).

motion.scroll: Smooth scrolling (Lenis highly recommended, or CSS smooth scroll).
motion.reveal: Text reveal on scroll, staggered entries for lists/bento items.
motion.interactions: Magnetic CTA hover, animated underline for links, subtle project image tilt on hover, pointer spotlight effect on project cards.
motion.parallax: Gentle portrait parallax in hero section.
motion.navigation: Active nav indicator sliding effect, floating glass nav appearing on scroll down.
motion.accessibility: MUST respect prefers-reduced-motion media query for all animations.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure WCAG AA contrast for text against dark backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings (e.g., ring-2 ring-blue-500 ring-offset-2 ring-offset-[#0A0D14]).
accessibility.aria: Use aria-hidden='true' on decorative oversized numbers and parallax elements.
accessibility.motion: Wrap complex animations with prefers-reduced-motion checks.

media.images: Use high-quality, professional imagery. Desaturate slightly or use blend modes (luminosity) to fit the dark editorial theme.

3d_libraries.framer_motion: Core library for scroll reveals, staggered bento entries, active nav indicators, and magnetic hovers.
3d_libraries.lucide_react: Clean, consistent icons for UI elements.

hero_portrait.description: Professional portrait of a woman in a dark studio setting for the Hero section.

project_mockup_1.description: Minimalist laptop mockup in a dark setting for Featured Project 01.

project_mockup_2.description: Minimalist laptop mockup for Featured Project 02.

data_background.description: Abstract wavy pattern for subtle background textures or Next Build slot.

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize standard React app structure using Vite. Use JavaScript (.jsx) for all components.
Install tailwindcss, framer-motion, lucide-react, clsx, tailwind-merge.
Setup routing (react-router-dom) if needed, but a single-page scrolling portfolio is preferred.
Create a modular folder structure: src/components/ui, src/components/sections.
Apply Playfair Display from Google Fonts in index.html.
Implement the Navigation bar to be floating, glassmorphic, and highlight active sections on scroll.
In the Hero section, ensure ARPITA NAIR is massively oversized, and the portrait image is framed elegantly.
Implement the 'Professional Snapshot' as a tight bento grid right below the hero.
For 'Education' and 'Experience', use a vertical timeline approach with subtle border tracking.
For 'Resume', build a document-style preview card with 'VIEW CV' and 'DOWNLOAD CV' buttons.
Ensure the 'Career Direction' section uses a typography-led flow with arrows.
All interactive elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for floating navigation.
NEVER use generic AI emojis (🤖, 💡, etc.) for icons; stick to lucide-react.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Every interaction needs micro-animations: hover states, transitions, entrance animations.
Do NOT apply 'transition: all'. Apply specific transitions like 'transition-transform', 'transition-opacity'.
Do NOT center align the app container. Respect optical alignment over geometrical alignment.
Use pill-shaped or slightly rounded (rounded-md) technical buttons with interaction animations.
Do not use complete transparent backgrounds for overlays or navbars. Use bg-[#0A0D14]/70 with backdrop-blur.
